\section[(dialogue)]{Owning and being able — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GU-R109-first-pass-owning-and-being-able}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for rubbish and a basket.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item some, this much, that much, here, there
  \item to be able to, with, strength, power, a right
  \item authority, a chance, property, wealth, an owner
  \item experience, a habit, a habit, a qualification, an art
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Some? (\textbf{\gu{અમુક}}.) This much? (\textbf{\gu{આટલું}}.) That much? (\textbf{\gu{એટલું}}.) Here? (\textbf{\gu{અહીં}}.) There? (\textbf{\gu{ત્યાં}}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\gu{શકવું}}.) With? (\textbf{\gu{પાસે}}.) Strength? (\textbf{\gu{તાકાત}}.) Power? (\textbf{\gu{શક્તિ}}.) A right? (\textbf{\gu{હક}}.) Authority? (\textbf{\gu{અધિકાર}}.) A chance? (\textbf{\gu{તક}}.) Property? (\textbf{\gu{મિલકત}}.) Wealth? (\textbf{\gu{સંપત્તિ}}.) An owner? (\textbf{\gu{માલિક}}.) Experience? (\textbf{\gu{અનુભવ}}.) A habit? (\textbf{\gu{ટેવ}}.) A habit? (\textbf{\gu{આદત}}.) A qualification? (\textbf{\gu{લાયકાત}}.) An art? (\textbf{\gu{કળા}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GU-R109-second-pass-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tool and to keep.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a tool, to keep, to possess, to win, to lose
  \item a cupboard, a mirror, a comb, soap, a towel
  \item a mattress, a bedsheet, a blanket, a step, a stove
  \item a vessel, a knife, scissors, a needle, a thread
  \item a button, a bucket, a broom, rubbish, a basket
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A tool? (\textbf{\gu{સાધન}}.) To keep? (\textbf{\gu{રાખવું}}.) To possess? (\textbf{\gu{ધરાવવું}}.) To win? (\textbf{\gu{જીતવું}}.) To lose? (\textbf{\gu{હારવું}}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{\gu{કબાટ}}.) A mirror? (\textbf{\gu{અરીસો}}.) A comb? (\textbf{\gu{કાંસકો}}.) Soap? (\textbf{\gu{સાબુ}}.) A towel? (\textbf{\gu{ટુવાલ}}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\gu{ગાદલું}}.) A bedsheet? (\textbf{\gu{ચાદર}}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\gu{ધાબળો}}.) A step? (\textbf{\gu{પગથિયું}}.) A stove? (\textbf{\gu{ચૂલો}}.) A vessel? (\textbf{\gu{વાસણ}}.) A knife? (\textbf{\gu{છરી}}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\gu{કાતર}}.) A needle? (\textbf{\gu{સોય}}.) A thread? (\textbf{\gu{દોરો}}.) A button? (\textbf{\gu{બટન}}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\gu{બાલદી}}.) A broom? (\textbf{\gu{સાવરણી}}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{\gu{કચરો}}.) A basket? (\textbf{\gu{ટોપલી}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
